name: Valor Estate Limited
summary: Valor Estate Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate development company in India. The company's portfolio consists of residential, commercial, retail, office, luxury and mass housing, cluster redevelopment, hospitality, and other projects. It serves individuals and entities. The company was formerly known as D B Realty Limited and changed its name to Valor Estate Limited in March 2024. Valor Estate Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
